print(json.dumps({'simulation_exit':p.returncode,'stdout':p.stdout,'stderr':p.stderr}),flush=True);assert p.returncode==0

 assert not any(s in n for s in ['dkms','amdgpu-dkms','linux-image','rocm-llvm','hipcc','gcc-','g++','-sdk','-dev']) or n in ['libtinfo-dev','rocprofiler-sdk-roctx'],('Unapproved package',n)
rows=[]
for name in names:
 p=subprocess.run(['apt-cache','show',name],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=15);assert p.returncode==0
 text=p.stdout.split('\n\n',1)[0];fields=dict(line.split(': ',1) for line in text.splitlines() if ': ' in line and not line.startswith(' '))
 rows.append({k:fields.get(k) for k in ['Package','Version','Size','Installed-Size','Filename','SHA256','Depends']})
print(json.dumps({'proposed_packages':rows,'compressed_bytes':sum(int(x['Size']) for x in rows),'installed_bytes_upper_sum':sum(int(x['Installed-Size'])*1024 for x in rows)}),flush=True)
